messages:
noah: hey team, accepted the org invite but my forks and open PRs from my existing account vanished from the repo list. Can't re-run Actions (403).
alice: did you accept with the same github username you use for your forks? sometimes people have two accounts with the same display name.
noah: i thought so. my username is @noahcodes on personal and i used it here too. the PR I opened yesterday from my fork doesn't show under the org at all.
it-ops: can you paste the exact Actions banner or screenshot? also which email is on your GitHub account?
noah: banner says `403 Forbidden — Organization requires SSO SAML` and my github account email is noah.personal@outlook.com. my work email is noah@redwood.ai
security-bot: notice: Redwood Inference enforces org SSO + verified work email. See onboarding guide: https://redwood.dev/onboard/github
alice: sounds like GitHub created an SSO-provisioned identity tied to noah@redwood.ai which is separate from the personal account that owns your fork. Two accounts with same username are allowed.
noah: oh that explains missing PRs. what's the cleanest way to preserve PRs and link accounts?
it-ops: two options:
1) add your work email to the personal account and enable 2FA; then we run an org mapping sync so GitHub links the account to SSO (keeps PRs intact).
2) if you want separate SSO account, we can transfer the fork/PR to the SSO account but author attribution may show the SSO identity.

If you want option 1, add noah@redwood.ai to Settings > Emails, verify, enable TOTP 2FA, then post here and I'll trigger a manual mapping sync.
noah: i added the work email and verified it. enabled 2FA now.
it-ops: thanks — running mapping sync now. i'll also temporarily grant write to repo "tools" so you can re-run CI while we sort membership.
it-ops: mapping sync complete. invited username @noahcodes (SSO-linked) into teams: eng, ci. confirmed your fork/PR is visible again.
noah: can re-run Actions and it accepted the job :tada: PR shows up and commits are intact.
alice: welcome aboard! when you have a sec drop a quick intro in #new-hires-intros. Also ping me if you'd like help consolidating SSH keys across accounts.
noah: will do, thanks so much for the fast help — saved my PR and history :relieved:
